subject: prd/e2e-verification
statement: The e2e-plan tasks shall be ordinary tracker tasks in the shape the existing executor already consumes, adding no e2e-specific task type.
rationale: so implement-now picks them up unchanged; e2e-specific handling is the deferred adaptation
fit_criterion: inspection confirms the produced tasks use the existing task/charter schema with no new required field; the executor's frontier computation accepts them unchanged
